2 Chapainawabganj 'Razakars' to face tribunal Sept 23
2014-09-18T13:04:55+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/2-chapainawabganj-razakars-to-face-tribunal-sept-23-42263

A tribunal in Dhaka today asked the jail authorities to produce two war crimes suspect of Chapainawabganj before it on September 23.

Chapainawabganj police arrested Mahidur Rahman, 84, of Dadanchak village and Afsar Hossain alias Chutu, 65, of Satrosia village in Shibganj upazila on Tuesday in a bomb blast and killing case.

The International Crimes Tribunal-2 led by its chairman Justice Obaidul Hasan came up with today’s order in response to a petition filed by the prosecutors seeking its directives for showing them arrested in a war crimes case.

In the petition, the prosecution also prayed to the court to keep the accused in jail for proper investigation that began on February 11. They are now in Chapainawabganj jail.
